# Autopay

Autopay charges a customer's saved card on the day an invoice is due, so you
don't have to chase the payment.

## Turn on Autopay for a customer

1. Open **Customers** and select the customer.
2. Select **Turn on Autopay**.
3. Ask the customer to save a card the next time they pay an invoice. Autopay
   starts with their next invoice after that.

## When a charge fails

If the card is declined, Ledgerly emails you and the customer, and the invoice
stays open. Autopay tries the card again 3 days later.

## Turn off Autopay

Open the customer and select **Turn off Autopay**. Invoices you have already
sent stay as they are.
